task: Replace scripts/verify.py with plain prek hooks and cached pytest
rules: Maintenance tooling stays independent of application runtime, SDK and analysis imports (tests/test_tooling_boundaries.py release_import_findings allowlist); analysis tools never become runtime dependencies (same test file); docs/development.md owns the release and hook procedure.

modules.responsibility: Create validated local version commits and tags, install the project's Git hooks, and own the byte-exact root version token rewrite.
modules.interface: The CLI modes --install-hooks, --post-commit and --changelog, plus the default retry, are unchanged. version_bytes(content, version, lock=, name=) keeps the verifier's behaviour: exactly one root version token is replaced and anything else raises an error. Generated release commits and tag recovery run hooks with SKIP set to the heavy hook IDs.
modules.effects: Owns Git, semantic-release and prek subprocesses, the release lock, the attempt record and hook files. Effects stay within its CLI.

modules.responsibility: Removed. Fingerprinted receipt reuse is replaced by prek hook file filters, testmon selection and SKIP on generated release commits.
modules.interface: No interface remains. Current guidance points to the direct commands.
modules.effects: None after removal. The private .git/verification data is left untouched for the user.

modules.responsibility: Declare hygiene, changelog, static analysis, cached pytest, documentation and post-commit release hooks for prek.
modules.interface: Hook IDs ruff, mypy, vulture, import-linter, pytest-full, pytest and check-docs. The release helper skips the heavy IDs by name.
allowed_dependencies: locked dev tools through uv run --frozen --no-sync
forbidden_dependencies: unlocked second copies of analysis tools
modules.effects: prek runs the configured subprocesses serially. pytest-testmon writes the ignored .testmondata file.

contracts.rules: local_release.py imports only the standard library, loguru and pydantic. Runtime, SDK, dynamic-import and relative-import forms are rejected by the negative parametrized cases. The scripts.verify allowance is removed.
Analysis packages, including prek and pytest-testmon, are never runtime dependencies.

checks.expectation: The release helper passes the import allowlist. Injected runtime, SDK and dynamic imports are rejected. Runtime dependencies contain no analysis packages.

Real-Git release fixtures pass. The heavy pytest hook runs on the contributor commit and is skipped on the release commit and tag recovery. A failing quality check leaves no tag. version_bytes cases pass.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check . && uv run --frozen --no-sync mypy . && uv run --frozen --no-sync vulture && uv run --frozen --no-sync lint-imports && uv run --frozen --no-sync pytest --testmon-noselect
checks.expectation: Every check exits 0. The complete ordinary suite, including the architecture negatives and CPU-DDP, passes.
Markdown and local links are valid after the guidance updates and the verify.py removal.

documentation: AGENTS.md, docs/development.md, docs/agent-workflow.md, docs/static-analysis.md, docs/current-contracts.md, docs/local-documentation.md, specs/000-baseline/spec.md (current contract text) and .agents/skills/running-end-to-end-tests/SKILL.md.
